brief: Long, narrow industrial cafe with exposed brick side walls, black ceiling with silver ductwork and track lights. Floor-to-ceiling steel-framed windows run along the left wall, with a timber window-bar ledge and black metal stools facing the street. The center holds one long reclaimed-wood communal table with black metal chairs; small round bistro tables with bentwood chairs sit along the right brick wall. At the back, a matte black counter with a wood top carries an espresso machine, grinders and a lit pastry case. Behind it are a chalkboard menu, open shelves with cups and coffee bags, and a warm backlit tile splash. Mood is warm, moody and inviting. Black dome pendants hang overhead, and potted plants, small flower vases, framed black-and-white prints, and coffee cups with croissants are on the tables.
